text.p: Petrofields Exploration and Development Co Inc said on Tuesday it planned to venture into power generation and water supply projects to support its core business of oil exploration.

Petrofields first vice president Adolfo Garcia told reporters that the company was planning to put up a mini-hydroelectric power plant and a water supply system, but declined to say in which part of the country.
Petrofields recently entered into a deal to develop a 240 hectare property in the northern Philippines into a mixed use residential, commercial and recreational estate.

"If oil exploration will be your core business then you must have some strong support from non-oil businesses such as power generation which we have been studying since last year, water supply and other opportunities that may come along," Garcia said.
